text: A private lender's file now shows the loan itself — amount, rate, term, LTV against the appraisal and LTC against the price, the carry, and who is borrowing — beside the documents going to underwriting.
Settings is now grouped into labelled sections, switching something off no longer shuffles other sections around the page, and the Handbook explains what each of its switches turns off.
Workspaces that take private lending work now get a loan file with no buy or sell side, a one-click thirteen-document underwriting package, and a note of which invoices still come out of the closing.
Compliance checklists can now be written for the buy side, sell side or a dual file, with a different default per client, and every transaction shows how close it is to closing-ready from any tab.
Reports now include a full time report: hours and effective hourly rate per file, per client and per person, over any window you pick.
Tasks now open their own screen where you can write a document, log a call, upload a file, and record what happened, without leaving the task.
